summary: Verified the AUDIT_TEMUAN_2026-09-02 backlog end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter293_audit_backlog.py (19 tests, 19 pass) covering P1-1 driver write guard vs read access, P1-3 loaded->prepared 'Bongkar' (manage + mandatory reason + loaded_at reset + timeline note), L-1 today WIB, L-2 lat/lng 422 + DELETE position (403 driver / 200 admin), L-3 my-route active-only, L-4 combined POD+NAMA PENERIMA message, L-8 non-dispatched SJ rejected, L-9 logistics_delivered notification addressed to sales users, G-3 /design-gallery-ai/status keys + gemini/test 400 without key, G-8 daily limit 1 -> 2nd illustration 400 'Batas', G-6 comment notification + delete-own-only rule, X-5 division 'logistics'/'Logistik'. Frontend (prebuilt bundle, public URL): L-5 debounced search (no Enter) + Cari button, L-6 search empty state + reset, L-7 step hint above actions, L-10 confirm dialogs (Bongkar/Berangkat), L-11 Esc closes only the askReason dialog (detail modal stays open), receiver prefilled from receiver_name_hint + Tandai Terkirim disabled without POD, logistics-pos-del for admin, P1-2 shipment-logistics chip in order detail navigating to Logistik detail modal, G-2/G-4/G-5/G-6/G-1 gallery AI flow (MODE DEMO badge, Ukuran penuh link, comment badge count, comment delete confirm, illustration delete confirm), X-1 Indonesian permission labels incl. 'Sopir / Kurir (Logistik)' + 'Logistik / Pengiriman', X-2 'Masuk (login)' label + 50 rows + 'Tampilkan 50 lagi (50 dari 186)' -> 100 rows, G-3/G-8 Gemini panel (MODE DEMO status, daily-limit input, cost estimate, no test button without key), X-3 title attributes on sidebar buttons. One real defect found: confirm dialog bodies are never rendered because ConfirmHost drops the `description` option.

minor.issue: Driver role bootstrap requests return 403 on every login (browser console errors). Pre-existing, unrelated to this backlog, but the shell should not fetch manage-only masters for `driver`.

ui_bugs.issue: ConfirmHost passes only `message={o.message}` to ConfirmModal, but 43 call sites (incl. AiIllustrationPanel G-1 delete, DeliveryDetailModal Bongkar/Gagal-kirim askReason, position delete) pass `description:`. Result: the dialog body/warning text is SILENTLY DROPPED everywhere. Verified live: G-1 dialog rendered only 'Hapus ilustrasi AI ini? Batal Hapus' (no comment-count warning), Bongkar dialog rendered no explanation. Fix: message={o.message || o.description} (or accept `description` in ConfirmModal) then rebuild the static bundle.

issues: ETA uses the browser-native date input (shows mm/dd/yyyy placeholder, US order) instead of the app date picker — inconsistent with Indonesian UI

action_items: Fix ConfirmHost.jsx so `description` reaches ConfirmModal (G-1 comment-count warning and all other dialog bodies are currently invisible), then rebuild the static bundle
Optional: stop fetching /api/document-templates and /api/uoms for role `driver` (403 console noise)
Optional: replace native date input for ETA with the app date picker
critical_code_review_comments: confirmService/ConfirmHost prop contract mismatch (`description` vs `message`) is a silent-data-loss class bug: consider validating unknown option keys in confirmService.request() so future typos fail loudly
logistics_service.transition() correctly resets loaded_at=None on Bongkar and writes the reason into the timeline — verified in DB response
logistics router applies _guard_driver_write on photos/positions/transition/photo-delete but NOT on DELETE positions (manage-only) — correct by design

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all executed checks passed; 3 checks not executable, see context)

seed_data_creation: Left in place as demo data: KSC/LG-00007 (own_fleet, driver Joko Susilo, SJ-00001/SO-0001, status Terkirim with load+POD photos, receiver 'Bu Ani') and KSC/LG-00008 (expedition JNE/JNE123, SJ-00004/SO-0003, status Dalam Perjalanan, 1 position 'Tol Cipali KM 72'). Test notifications (logistics_delivered/design_ai_comment) and the QA AI illustration + comment were deleted. gemini_daily_limit restored to 10; shipment statuses restored to 'dispatched' after the L-8 probe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both free dispatched shipments in ent_ksc are now consumed by LG-00007/LG-00008, so (a) shipment-logistics-none-{id} 'Belum diangkut logistik' could NOT be exercised on screen (code present at OrderDetailPanel.jsx:413), (b) the disabled state of logistics-act-loaded for a prepared delivery without load photo was confirmed visually (greyed button + hint 'Wajib unggah foto muat...') but the DOM assertion was not re-run after data moved on, and (c) DriverTodayPanel reorder buttons (driver-task-up/down, min-h 40px in code) had no active task to render. To retest these, free a shipment: db.logistics_deliveries + reset shipments.logistics_id/logistics_number/logistics_status and status='dispatched'. test_iter293_audit_backlog.py is re-runnable: test_01 auto-releases QA deliveries (vehicle_plate 'B 1 QA' / tracking 'JNE123') before running. Orders navigation: nav-group-toggle-penjualan -> nav-sales-orders -> hub-tab-orders -> tab-list -> order-card-{id} -> 'Lihat detail & aksi' to reach the shipment chip. Gallery: nav-designer-hub -> hub-tab-cs-design-gallery.
rca_of_the_issue: ConfirmHost.jsx forwards `message` only; confirmService callers standardised on `description` (43 usages). Because React silently ignores unknown option keys, every confirm/askReason dialog renders title + buttons with no body, which is why the G-1 requirement 'warns comment count' appears unimplemented at runtime even though AiIllustrationPanel.jsx:51-52 builds the warning string correctly.
